name: Celaro
title: celaro.co
shortDescription: Celaro is a project tracker designed specifically for creative agencies, focusing on designers and developers. It streamlines project management by breaking projects into clear stages and minimizing unnecessary interactions. An example use case would be a design agency using Celaro to manage multiple client projects efficiently, ensuring all team members are focused and productive.
cons: Lacks broad feature set of general project tools
Potentially steep learning curve for new users
